actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const t0 = Date.now(); for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); if (s.screen === 'play' && s.activeInstance) return { ms: Date.now() - t0, screen: s.screen, instance: s.activeInstance.instanceId ?? s.activeInstance }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'timeout: ' + S.useSessionStore.getState().screen })()
